definition: [ גָּרַס ] verb be crushed (Aramaic [ be crushed,] perish ) — Qal Perfect 3 feminine singular גָָּֽרְסָה Ps 119:20 figurative נַפְשִׁי לְ ׳ ג my soul is crushed (i.e. perisheth: compare Syriac) with longing for (compare כָּלָה לְ ). Hiph`il Imperfect וַיַּגְרֵס בֶּחָצָץ שִׁנָּ֑י Lam 3:16 and he hath crushed my teeth with gravel , figurative of divine chastisement.

Hiph`il Imperfect וַיַּגְרֵס בֶּחָצָץ שִׁנָּ֑י Lam 3:16 and he hath crushed my teeth with gravel, figurative of divine chastisement.
